title: Mobius
description: A Vanilla+ expansion featuring a mob leveling system, new ores and gear, lucky bags, and tea brewing.
body:
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e8a2248e85b52ecd818dc7077dc92a84fa61077.png)


**A Vanilla+ modification that expands the horizons of the standard survival experience. The mod introduces a mob leveling system to make combat more engaging, alongside new ores for crafting unique tools and armor. As a delightful bonus, enjoy lucky bags and the ability to brew tea.**



## **Mob Enhancement System**

Mobs are divided into 6 difficulty tiers. The enhancement only increases the mob's HP and damage; the higher the tier, the lower the spawn chance. Additionally, every enhanced mob drops extra loot, the quality of which depends on the mob's tier (this can be disabled in the settings menu). Tier 6 mobs have a 40% chance to drop a special item. A mob's tier is indicated by the number of "💀" symbols above its head.




## **Mob Enhancement Settings Menu**

Pressing the [M] key opens a menu where you can configure the HP, damage, spawn chance, and whether extra loot drops for the selected mob tier.



## **New Ores and Ingots**

- Steel Ingot: Sits somewhere between iron and diamond. It is created in a Blast Furnace by smelting iron ingots (the process takes a long time and requires a lot of coal).
- Gilded Copper Ingot: Better than diamond tools. It is crafted by combining a large amount of copper and gold. This material is truly expensive and requires a long crafting chain.
- Jade Ingot: An incredibly rare and top-tier material. It also has a complex crafting chain, but the difficulty of obtaining it is amplified by the rarity of Jade itself.



## **Fragment System**

You have the ability to double your farming efficiency for resources like iron, gold, copper, and coal—though it requires spending more time and Blast Furnace fuel. You need to cut Raw Iron, Raw Gold, or Raw Copper on a Stonecutter into fragments. After that, you can smelt them in a Blast Furnace to get smelted fragments, which can then be combined to yield twice as many ingots compared to simply smelting the raw metals. Additionally, by cutting wood blocks into stick fragments, you can quickly and efficiently smelt charcoal.



## **Lucky Bag System**

Enhanced mobs can drop a Bag Fragment. By using it in crafting along with a Bag (created from boiled leather), you can craft a Tier 1 Lucky Bag. This bag contains useful resources, and with a small chance, very rare ones. There are 3 tiers of bags. Each subsequent tier is crafted using 3 lower-tier bags and a Lead.



## **Tea Brewing System**

You have the option to brew several types of tea. Each provides 2 effects for 10 minutes and is suited for different tasks, such as mining trips, PvP, or increasing survivability.

- Tea is made in a Brewing Stand using Water Bottles and tea leaves.
- Tea leaves can be gathered from tea bushes in the Jungle. You can also use special modded Tea Tongs to increase gathering efficiency.
- After gathering, you need to dry the leaves and process them into tea shreds/pieces.
- Once you've brewed regular tea, you can upgrade it by brewing it a second time. By adding Honey, a Green Tea Leaf, a Black Tea Leaf, or Sweet Berries, you will get a specific tea that provides different effects.
 


## **New Chests and Backpacks**

- Trash Can Chest: Has 22 slots that can be emptied by pressing a button.
- Steel Chest: Has 71 slots.
- Gilded Copper Chest: Has 117 slots.
- Steel Backpack: Has 27 slots.
- Jade Backpack: Has 73 slots. 5 of these slots act as a trash can (with the same deletion function), and 2 slots are dedicated to an disenchantment feature, allowing you to remove enchantments from an item and gain experience.

## **Enhanced Wolf Breeding System**
You can now find and tame enhanced wolves in the world, marked with a "✦" symbol. The number of symbols indicates the mob's power level. Afterward, you can breed these wolves to get an offspring with more stars and improved stats.

## **Custom Balancing Recipes**

The mod also adds a few custom recipes for balance:
- The ability to cook Rotten Flesh into Leather in a Smoker.



## Supports languages:

English (only united kingdom) 100%

Ukrainian 100%

Belarusian 100%

Kazakh 74%

Polish 83%

Russian 100%**
